column4: Visit note | 2025-10-01 09:30 AM | Dr. Shamima Nasrin, Ophthalmology | Patient: Anwar Dewan, 74, male. Mr. Dewan returns for a follow-up visit complaining of gritty, burning eyes that feel much worse when he is sitting in air conditioning. He works as a homemaker, and his symptoms began after long gaming sessions at home in Narayanganj. He has a known history of Essential hypertension. He denies sudden vision loss, flashing lights, or discharge. On examination: tear break-up time 3 seconds, BP 146/93 mmHg, pulse 88 bpm, weight 92 kg. Corneas are clear and anterior chambers are quiet. Assessment: Dry eye syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued for lubricant eye drops. He was advised to look away from the screen every 20 minutes, blink often, and use a humidifier. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-10-02 03:30 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Imtiaz Sikder, 37, male. Mr. Sikder visits for the first time complaining of painful swallowing and a sore throat. He works as an electrician, and his trouble began after shouting at a cricket match in Lalbagh. He has a comorbidity of Essential hypertension. He reports no shortness of breath, ear pain, or skin rashes. On examination: temperature 100.8°F, BP 150/96 mmHg, pulse 93 bpm, weight 50 kg. His throat shows erythematous and enlarged tonsils with mild exudate. Assessment: Acute tonsillitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to gargle with warm salt water, eat soft food, and drink plenty of fluids. Follow-up in 1 week.
